speaker.name: Requirements Reuben
speaker.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

output.objection: You have listed my compliance gate as a delay without noting that it protects us from the legal duty to stock advertised promotions. I need that trade off acknowledged explicitly in the plan so the team understands why we cannot skip it.
output.correction: I am not asking you to slow down the forecast job for the sake of bureaucracy. I am asking you to treat the loyalty data consent checks as a hard requirement for the promotion allocation model, not an optional extra.
